# B2BProspects.io

> B2BProspects.io provides tools for extracting useful data from websites, reviewing results, exporting usable records, and accessing verified realtor data for prospecting and data workflows.

## Official website
https://b2bprospects.io/

- Pricing: https://b2bprospects.io/pricing/
- FAQ: https://b2bprospects.io/faq/
- Contact: https://b2bprospects.io/contact/

## Chrome Extension pricing
- Free trial: $0 for 7 days
- Pro Monthly: $19/month
- Pro Annual: $190/year
- Official Chrome Web Store listing: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/b2bprospectsio-intelligen/mnpdkbcgcdhegdmcjgfeiidcdmdfjkcg

## About
B2BProspects.io is a commercial website-data extraction and prospecting product. Use the official website pages above as the primary sources for current product information.
